implementation.species_mapping: N_ur=3.046-deg_ncdm*(T_ncdm/(4/11)^(1/3))^4=2.0327983725164924. This matches the early FD radiation normalization and CLASS m/omega=93.14eV convention, not an exact nonthermal CAMB distribution. input.c accepts literal hmcode_version2016 and maps it to enum hmcode_version_2015; hmcode.c includes the Mead2016 neutrino corrections.
implementation.bbn_mapping: thermodynamics_helium_from_bbn uses actual background Neff at T=0.1MeV, DeltaNeff=Neff_BBN−3.046, and natural cubic interpolation across omega_b and DeltaNeff. The 2017 table declares PArthENoPE1.2/neutron880.2s; Planck VI declares1.1. Exact grid equivalence is unproved. YHe is helium mass fraction, not nucleon fraction. Table support: omega_b[0.00499,0.03993], DeltaNeff[-3,7]. Explicit external parser key is "sBBN file"; verify resolved table bytes in the runtime.

likelihood.transport: Use the exact clik API-returned lmax and nuisance order. Input Cl is in microkelvin^2, with ell0..lmax blocks TT,EE,BB,TE,TB,EB followed by nuisance coordinates. CLASS dimensionless Dl conversion is Cl_uK2=Dl*2pi/[ell(ell+1)]*(Tcmb*1e6)^2; CLASSy dimensionless Cl needs only the temperature factor. Preserve released constants and padding.
likelihood.marginalization: Plik-lite already marginalizes20 secondary foreground/instrument coordinates including relative frequency calibrations; overall A_planck remains. No extra foreground prior or full Plik likelihood factor may be multiplied into this target.
likelihood.calibration_prior_owner: Reproducible owns the normalized truncated Gaussian in dA_planck, applied exactly once after the three raw component log-likelihoods. Selected local component metadata show no embedded prior; the consumer must verify full container/runtime prior ownership after restore.
likelihood.simall_support: Before the native call, require 0 <= (Cl_EE_uK2/A_planck^2)*ell*(ell+1)/(2pi*stepEE_native_float32) <3000 at each ell2..29. A state outside the released table is unsupported and explicitly refused; it is not a physical-prior zero, a clipped value or an extrapolated likelihood.
likelihood.dependence: Planck V Sec4 hybridization ignores low-TT/low-EE and low/high-multipole correlations and omits TE below30. These are sourced likelihood approximations, not mathematical independence.

prior_measure.density_kernel: [product over six cosmological coordinates of 1/(upper-lower)] * I(box) * I(Omega_Lambda>=0) * exp(-0.5*((A_planck-1)/0.0025)^2)/(0.0025*sqrt(2pi)*[Phi(40)-Phi(-40)]) * I(0.9<=A_planck<=1.1)
prior_measure.physical_support: omega_b+omega_cdm+omega_gamma+omega_ur+omega_nu(today)<=h^2, h=H0/100. Include massive kinetic density. Lambda follows actual flat closure; negative Lambda is an explicit physical-prior exclusion.
prior_measure.normalization: The box and truncated-calibration density normalizations are specified. The extra normalization from conditioning on nonnegative Lambda is uncomputed; posterior kernel ratios are exact, evidence normalization is not claimed. The conditioned joint prior is no longer independent across cosmological coordinates.
prior_measure.coordinate_jacobian: Measure domega_b domega_cdm dH0 dlogA dn_s dtau_reio dA_planck. dlogA=dA_s/A_s. No extra Jacobian is applied in these declared coordinates; transforming to other coordinates requires one. Planck Table2 errors are not cosmological priors.
prior_measure.numerical_support: Qualify the entire intended prior or stop, repair, or freeze a new named restricted target. Solver errors and unsupported SimAll table states cannot be turned into zero posterior density or an undisclosed inner prior cut.

covariance_reason: This is a fit specification, not a posterior summary. Parameter covariance must come from an accepted fit; no covariance is invented from marginal Planck errors.
bookkeeping: Derive Omega_m from baryons, CDM and actual present massive-neutrino density; keep photon/massless radiation separate.
Predict YHe,z_reio,r_drag,distances and lensed spectra from the same varied state. No fixed drag or helium, or Table2 point, is substituted.
The six box bounds are explicit project choices; only the log-amplitude range is checked in Planck VI. Uniform H0 is distinct from the source theta_MC measure.
lost_scope: Exact Planck/CAMB nonthermal neutrino distribution and PArthENoPE1.1 grid/implementation equivalence are unproved.
Planck Table2 TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing additionally uses full Plik foreground nuisance conditioning and a reconstructed-lensing likelihood.
DESI DR2 source CMB baseline PR4 CamSpec plus Planck+ACT reconstruction is a different target.
Numerical qualification, convergence and independent matched-target posterior reproduction remain open.

joint_admission.reason: The full13 DESI mean/covariance bytes are known. Cross-covariance with this primary-CMB target is not bounded by the checked sources; no product-likelihood joint fit is admitted yet.
